|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 2. Once during your control phase (twice if on ''Devastator'') may use 1 Force to ▲any Imperial pilot of ability < 3.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your control phase (twice if aboard ''Devastator''), may use 1 Force to take an Imperial pilot of ability < 3 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 2. Once during” → “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During”; “on ''Devastator'')” → “aboard ''Devastator''),”; “▲any” → “take an”; “3.” → “3 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
